schema.title: Wangscape terrain hypergraph schema
schema.description: Specifies the clique memberships of each terrain in a Wangscape configuration.

^[0-9a-zA-Z_-]+$.title: Clique list schema
^[0-9a-zA-Z_-]+$.description: Lists all the cliques which contain a certain terrain.

items.title: Clique schema
items.description: Specifies a terrain clique as a list of terrain IDs.

description: According to the current Wangscape configuration, the terrain grassland participates in two cliques: one pairing it with forest, and a three‑terrain clique that joins grassland with hill and river. The desert terrain is linked in a duo with mountain and also forms a desert‑oasis pair. Water‑related tiles are grouped as a water‑river pair and a larger water‑lake‑swamp triple. Finally, the high‑altitude terrain mountain_peak appears in two cliques, one with snow and another with rocky.
